planets.name: GJ 357 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of GJ 357 with a 3.93-day year, found in 2019.

text.card: GJ 357 b was found in 2019 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around GJ 357. Its orbit and size follow Oddo et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
